archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) - Adapted for Industrial HMI

fonts.usage: Body text, UI labels, standard forms, table headers
Numerical data, calculations, scientific molding sheet readouts, metrics

rules: No Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings.
Metrics and calculation results must use JetBrains Mono to simulate industrial machine readouts.
Overlines for data points must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
No full-screen gradients. Use flat, solid colors for a hardware/machine interface feel.
Use #8b5cf6 (violet) strictly for highlighting AI-suggested defect solutions from Claude Sonnet.
Never use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) as per forbidden rules for dashboards.
Always set hover text colors explicitly.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) - Flat solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders. Minimal rounded corners (rounded-sm or rounded-none) to mimic industrial hardware.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on 1px borders (border-slate-700) to separate surfaces. If shadow is needed, use hard, small drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in forms and data tables. Only permissible for fixed top navigation bars (bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800).

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Direct children must be grid items.
grids_and_layouts.forms: High-density data forms (Scientific Molding Calculator) must be multi-column on desktop (md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) to fit tablet view efficiently without excessive scrolling.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Industrial UI requires clear separation but dense data. Use p-4 to p-6 for card internals, but allow dense tables (p-2).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Data columns right-aligned for numbers, left-aligned for text. Labels above inputs for faster scanning on tablets.

motion.strategy: Minimalist and precise. Industrial tools should feel immediate.
rules: Use short duration color transitions: transition-colors duration-150.
No bouncy spring animations or slow parallax.
Micro-interactions on hover (bg color shift) for table rows and buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Must meet minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Warning (Amber) and Error (Red) must be readable against dark slate.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 40x40px for all interactive elements to support tablet usage on the factory floor (use h-10 or h-12 for inputs/buttons).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).

component_instructions.general: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for main layout structures. Heavily customize Shadcn components to match the flat, industrial slate aesthetic.
component_instructions.buttons: Flat, sharp corners (rounded-sm). Action buttons (blue), Destructive (red). Use solid colors, no gradients.
component_instructions.cards: Remove default soft shadows from Shadcn Cards. Use bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-sm.
component_instructions.inputs: bg-slate-950 border-slate-700 rounded-sm focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500. Height must be h-10 min for tablet touch.
component_instructions.tables: Shadcn Table. Dense styling. Hover rows should be bg-slate-800. Header text uppercase, tracking-wider, text-slate-400.
component_instructions.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, technical dashboard look.
component_instructions.charts: If needed for molding parameters overtime, use Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Color blind friendly palettes.

images.description: Factory with machines, used for the left or right panel of the login screen to establish industrial context.

rules: Do not use placeholder image services.
Images should have a dark overlay (bg-slate-950/60) so they don't overpower the UI.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Industrial aesthetic: keep corners sharp, borders distinct, and contrast high.
Create new components matching the style of existing ones.
